qualification_rule: A qualifying route must join a durable pre-existing community machine identity to a current public hosted operation that anonymously and without payment fetches Agent Guild preflight/check/passport or verifies an Agent Guild credential and returns a substantive result. Registry listings, schemas, fixed self-tests, discovery probes, inactive runtimes, and caller-supplied artifact validation do not qualify.

strict_result.reason: No candidate simultaneously satisfied durable fixed-target identity, current live execution, an exact useful Agent Guild operation, and anonymous no-payment/no-terms/no-install access. The one-call allowance was deliberately left unused because no published contract cleared every precondition.

targets.identity_join: The sole current registry hit is labelled AutoGen, not current AG2, and its public record does not prove that the hosted runtime uses AG2.
targets.gate: Required Smithery credential plus unresolved AutoGen-to-current-AG2 runtime provenance. No anonymous public operation was available.
